text_block_list.text: A calm, early summer day shortly after the big race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A rest, you say?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ――Understood! A strategy formulated for my conditioning. Then this Yaeno Muteki shall put her heart and soul into resting!
It was only for a few days, and class load was light, so I wanted her to unwind a little. That was the intent behind the break.
Next day after school. Passing by the training grounds on my way back――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……Phew. A splendid session.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah! Th-this is, well……!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Forgive me! I know full well I am ordered to rest! But without physical discipline, my spirit simply cannot settle!
……Her earnest devotion was both her greatest strength and charm. But right now, rest was essential!
choice_data_list: Anyways, no training during this break!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haa……! Forgive me for causing you worry. My lack of discipline shames me……!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……I will take this failure to heart. I shall change immediately and return to the dorms…… My apologies.
And so we parted for the day…… But could Yaeno Muteki truly put her 『Training on Hold』?
Day two of Yaeno Muteki's mandatory break.
Not here――
Not here either――
Nor here.
Mindful of yesterday, I checked every training spot on campus…… Yaeno Muteki was nowhere to be seen.
Perhaps she was relaxing in the dorms or out with friends. Since she was resting properly, I decided to head into town for some errands!
On my way back, I took a small detour. A place filled with memories. That day――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
――Hah! ……Sei! 
……Haa! ……Toh!
Just like that day, solitary, honing her spirit through rigorous training. Every crisp movement was proof of hard-earned discipline. Or so I recalled――
Right, just like that, Yaeno Muteki was pushing herself through training――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……Ah.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what a coincidence! 
Are you out taking a stroll as well?
choice_data_list: You were training just now, weren't you?
You were training just now, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……Yes, I am……!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To obey your command, I left campus and its training grounds behind. All went well at first, but……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The moment I laid eyes on this underpass, nostalgic fighting spirit surged within me…… There is no excuse. I am utterly disgraced!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Being left to my own devices proved too much…… When idle time presents itself, my instinct commands me to train……
Frustrated at not training properly, or distressed at failing to rest? Likely both――she hung her head in dejection.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: B-but Trainer-dono, you prescribed this rest for my own growth……
choice_data_list: I wasn't trying to completely stop you……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
……! Osu! 
Then I shall press on with my current regimen!
In the end, she trained until sunset. Teaching Yaeno Muteki how to rest was going to be a formidable trial……!
